title: MonetizeKit Stage Review lens catalog (.github/stage-review.json)
description: Per-repository catalog of review lenses for the batched model review of a stage head. Each lens names a policy role (agent-policy.json), the deterministic partners that run first, the paths it judges and its graduation mode. Plain code turns lens results into the check-run verdict; the model only informs.

base.description: Branch the stage promotes into; the review range is base..head

blocking_labels.description: Finding labels that fail a lens in gate mode; nit never blocks by policy

kind.description: script: run by run-partners.mjs, emits a partner report; job: a workflow job in stage-review.yml (e.g. CodeQL); upstream: an existing required check or observing loop cited as evidence

job.description: Job id in stage-review.yml for kind=job

role.description: agent-policy.json role whose model reviews this lens

mode.description: planned: partners only, model not asked; shadow: model asked, never blocks; gate: important findings fail the check

paths.description: Globs; the lens is in scope when any changed file matches. Empty = every change.

partners.description: Partner ids; every lens pairs with at least one deterministic partner

judges.description: What the model judges that code cannot; injected into the prompt verbatim

never_report.description: Things a required check already enforces; the model must not report them

graduated_at.description: Date the lens moved to gate mode (required when mode is gate)
